description: Calendar arithmetic for Medicare Advantage appeal deadlines. Give notice_date (the date printed on the plan’s denial notice) for the plan reconsideration deadline: 65 days from that date (the rule is 60 days from receipt, presumed 5 days after the date). Or give care_end_date (the date covered skilled nursing, home health or outpatient rehab care ends, on the Notice of Medicare Non-Coverage), and notice_delivered_date (the day that notice was handed over) if known, for the fast appeal: by noon of the day after delivery; without the delivery date, noon the day before the end date, which holds only for a notice that came two days ahead. The notice’s own instructions come first.

care_end_date.description: The date covered care ends, from the Notice of Medicare Non-Coverage, YYYY-MM-DD.

notice_date.description: The date printed on the denial notice, YYYY-MM-DD.

notice_delivered_date.description: The day the Notice of Medicare Non-Coverage was delivered, YYYY-MM-DD (with care_end_date).
